helper_source:
"""Retain the discovered near-constant failure and real three-frame FFmpeg PTS."""
import hashlib,json,math,re,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
runtime=root/'product/.runtime'
def sha(p):return 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def load(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

if '--worker' in sys.argv:
    directory=Path(sys.argv[-1]);sys.path.insert(0,str(directory))
    from ai_ad_editor.render import _expr_arg,_speed_curve_segments
    from ai_ad_editor.time_mapping import compose_expression,curve_elapsed,make_map
    span=10000.;a=.01;b=a+4e-9
    clip={'source_in_tick':0,'source_out_tick':round(span*90000),'duration_tick':90000,
          'speed_curve':{'keyframes':[{'at_tick':0,'speed':a,'interpolation':'ease_in'},
                                      {'at_tick':round(span*90000),'speed':b}]}}
    segments=_speed_curve_segments(clip,round(span*90000),90000)
    def oracle(x):
        z=math.sqrt((b-a)/a)*x/span
        return x/a*(math.atan(z)/z if z else 1.)
    mapping=make_map(clip,segments,90000);mapping['curve_scale']=1.
    expression=compose_expression([mapping],'N*5000')
    video_filter='settb=expr=1/90000,setpts='+_expr_arg('('+expression+')/TB')+',showinfo'
    argv=['ffmpeg','-v','info','-f','lavfi','-i','color=size=16x16:rate=1:duration=3','-vf',video_filter,
          '-frames:v','3','-fps_mode','passthrough','-f','null','-']
    p=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,check=True)
    pts=[int(v) for v in re.findall(rb'\bn:\s*\d+\s+pts:\s*(-?\d+)',p.stderr)]
    assert len(pts)==3
    bound=segments.certificate['source_clock_error_bound_seconds']
    numeric_error=abs(curve_elapsed(segments,span)-oracle(span))
    encoded_error=max(abs(t/90000-oracle(i*5000)) for i,t in enumerate(pts))
    print(json.dumps({'span_seconds':span,'endpoint_speeds':[a,b],'certificate':segments.certificate,
        'oracle_total_seconds':oracle(span),'numeric_total_seconds':curve_elapsed(segments,span),
        'numeric_error_seconds':numeric_error,'ffmpeg_pts_ticks':pts,'pts_timebase':90000,
        'max_ffmpeg_pts_error_seconds':encoded_error,'within_reported_bound':numeric_error<=bound+1e-9,
        'ffmpeg_within_bound_plus_one_tick':encoded_error<=bound+1/90000,
        'actual_generated_frames':3,'output_is_null_diagnostic':True,'argv':argv,
        'ffmpeg_stderr':p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')}));raise SystemExit(0)

archive=runtime/'speed-easing-pre-stability-source-20261016'
old_full=load(runtime/'speed-easing-pre-stability-full-20261016.json')
assert old_full['status']=='passed' and old_full['test_count']==451
for name,digest in old_full['source_sha256_after'].items():assert sha(archive/name)==digest,name
assert sha(archive/'docs/specs/agent-project.schema.json')==old_full['schema_sha256_after']
results={}
for label,source in [('pre_stability',archive/'product/src'),('current',root/'product/src')]:
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','-X','utf8',str(Path(__file__)),'--worker',str(source)],cwd=root,capture_output=True,check=True)
    results[label]=json.loads(p.stdout.decode('utf-8-sig'))
assert not results['pre_stability']['within_reported_bound']
assert results['current']['within_reported_bound'] and results['current']['ffmpeg_within_bound_plus_one_tick']
dest=root/'docs/validation/evidence'
before_sources={n:{'sha256':sha(archive/n),'text':(archive/n).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')} for n in [
    'product/src/ai_ad_editor/time_mapping.py','product/src/ai_ad_editor/speed_curves.py']}
record={'scope':'Numerical correction after an otherwise passing intermediate 451-test run; distinct from Git baseline b0d0f42e',
        'before_and_after':results,'previous_full_regression':old_full,'archived_pre_stability_sources_verified':True,
        'pre_stability_modules':before_sources,'current_source_sha256':{n:sha(root/n) for n in before_sources},
        'three_frame_ffmpeg_only':True,'no_10000_second_video_encoded':True,'helper_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),
        'helper_source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'),'full_parity_accepted':False}
(dest/'speed-easing-stability-20261016.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({name:{key:value[key] for key in ['numeric_error_seconds','max_ffmpeg_pts_error_seconds','within_reported_bound']} for name,value in results.items()}))
